definition: a small piece of metal or plastic with a name or picture that you wear
sentence: Don't forget your {badge}, they won't let you in without it.
translation: Не забудь свой бейдж, без него тебя не пустят.

definition: very cruel and violent, like a wild animal
sentence: The reviews of her new film were really {savage}.
translation: Отзывы на её новый фильм были просто беспощадными.

definition: to stop moving or stop something from going on
sentence: The bus {halted} right in the middle of the bridge.
translation: Автобус остановился прямо посреди моста.

definition: a point where lines or parts of a system meet or connect
sentence: Every computer in the office is a {node} on the network.
translation: Каждый компьютер в офисе — узел сети.

definition: a person who pays money to live in a house or flat
sentence: The new {tenant} upstairs plays the drums at night.
translation: Новый жилец сверху играет на барабанах по ночам.

definition: to cut a small amount off something to make it neat
sentence: Can you {trim} my hair a little before the wedding?
translation: Можешь немного подровнять мне волосы перед свадьбой?

definition: a doctor for animals
sentence: We took the cat to the {vet} this morning.
translation: Утром мы отвезли кота к ветеринару.

definition: an action that breaks the law
sentence: Parking here is an {offence}, you will get a fine.
translation: Парковка здесь — нарушение, получишь штраф.

definition: a system where people or things take turns in a fixed order
sentence: We cook dinner in {rotation}, tonight it's my turn.
translation: Мы готовим ужин по очереди, сегодня моя.

definition: a person who moves to another place or country to find work
sentence: Many {migrants} come here for the summer harvest.
translation: Многие мигранты приезжают сюда на летний сбор урожая.

definition: to enter a place by force, especially with an army
sentence: Tourists {invade} this beach every July.
translation: Каждый июль на этот пляж обрушиваются туристы.

definition: the inside of your body where food goes, your stomach area
sentence: I had a bad feeling in my {gut} about that deal.
translation: У меня было дурное предчувствие насчёт той сделки.

definition: a performance of live music, especially by a small band
sentence: Our band has a {gig} on Friday at the pub.
translation: У нашей группы концерт в пятницу в пабе.

definition: having many parts or details, carefully planned
sentence: She made an {elaborate} cake with three floors and flowers.
translation: Она испекла замысловатый торт в три яруса с цветами.

definition: rock from which metal can be taken
sentence: The mine used to produce iron {ore}.
translation: Шахта когда-то добывала железную руду.

definition: a group of cells growing in the body in a way that is not normal
sentence: The doctors found a small {tumor} and removed it in time.
translation: Врачи нашли небольшую опухоль и вовремя её удалили.

definition: a very soft, light and expensive material made by small animals
sentence: This scarf is pure {silk}, be careful with it.
translation: Этот шарф из чистого шёлка, обращайся с ним аккуратно.

definition: to move text up or down on a screen with your finger or mouse
sentence: I {scrolled} through the menu but couldn't find the setting.
translation: Я пролистал меню, но так и не нашёл настройку.

definition: agreement with a rule, law or wish
sentence: In {accordance} with the rules, the game was replayed.
translation: В соответствии с правилами игру переиграли.

definition: very similar, almost the same
sentence: The twins look so {alike} that even their mum mixes them up.
translation: Близнецы так похожи, что даже мама их путает.

definition: true or relevant for a particular person or situation
sentence: The discount is {applicable} to students only.
translation: Скидка действует только для студентов.

definition: the fact that something can be bought, used or found
sentence: Call the hotel first to check {availability} for those dates.
translation: Сначала позвони в отель и узнай, есть ли места на эти даты.

definition: the head of government in some countries, or a senior official
sentence: The {chancellor} gave a speech about the budget tonight.
translation: Канцлер выступил сегодня вечером с речью о бюджете.

definition: the state of being awake and knowing what is happening
sentence: He lost {consciousness} for a few seconds after the fall.
translation: После падения он на несколько секунд потерял сознание.

definition: polite behaviour that shows respect for other people
sentence: He didn't even have the {courtesy} to call and cancel.
translation: Он даже не удосужился позвонить и отменить встречу.

definition: extremely interesting, hard to stop watching or listening
sentence: Her stories about Japan are {fascinating}.
translation: Её рассказы о Японии просто завораживают.

definition: money given or lent to pay for something
sentence: We got {financing} from the bank for the new kitchen.
translation: Мы взяли в банке финансирование на новую кухню.

definition: able to change easily when the situation changes
sentence: My hours are {flexible}, so I can pick up the kids.
translation: У меня гибкий график, так что я могу забирать детей.

definition: the quality of being kind and honest
sentence: Thank {goodness} you called, I was starting to worry.
translation: Слава богу, ты позвонил, я уже начал волноваться.

definition: the bad feeling you have when you know you did something wrong
sentence: I felt a wave of {guilt} for forgetting her birthday.
translation: Я почувствовал укол вины за то, что забыл её день рождения.

definition: work that teachers give students to do at home
sentence: I can't come out, I still have maths {homework}.
translation: Я не могу выйти, у меня ещё домашка по математике.

definition: very famous and seen as a symbol of something
sentence: That red phone box is an {iconic} picture of London.
translation: Эта красная телефонная будка — знаковый образ Лондона.

definition: very interested in something and wanting to do it
sentence: She's {keen} to start the course as soon as possible.
translation: Ей не терпится начать курс как можно скорее.

definition: smaller or less important than something else
sentence: Cold coffee is the {lesser} problem here, the milk has gone off.
translation: Холодный кофе здесь меньшая беда, молоко испортилось.

definition: something that must be done because the rules say so
sentence: Helmets are {mandatory} on this ride.
translation: На этом аттракционе шлем обязателен.

definition: the way something works or is done, or the study of forces and movement
sentence: I understand the {mechanics} of the app, I just don't like it.
translation: Я понимаю, как устроено приложение, просто оно мне не нравится.

definition: used to say how small or unimportant something is
sentence: It's a {mere} ten minutes on foot, let's not take a taxi.
translation: Это всего десять минут пешком, давай без такси.

definition: earth mixed with water, soft and dirty
sentence: The kids came home covered in {mud} after the match.
translation: После матча дети пришли домой все в грязи.

definition: exact and correct in every small part
sentence: Can you give me the {precise} time of the train?
translation: Можешь сказать точное время поезда?

definition: keeping someone or something safe from harm
sentence: Wear {protective} gloves when you clean the oven.
translation: Надевай защитные перчатки, когда чистишь духовку.

definition: according to what people say, though it is not confirmed
sentence: The cafe is {reportedly} opening again next month.
translation: Кафе, по слухам, снова открывается в следующем месяце.

definition: the act of living apart or being kept apart
sentence: After the {separation} he moved to a small flat near work.
translation: После расставания он переехал в маленькую квартиру рядом с работой.

definition: in a way that is connected with sex
sentence: The film is for adults because it is {sexually} explicit.
translation: Фильм для взрослых, потому что в нём откровенные сцены.

definition: the work of bringing an old building or object back to good condition
sentence: The {restoration} of the church took six years.
translation: Реставрация церкви заняла шесть лет.

definition: a list of people's names and the times they work or play
sentence: Check the {roster}, I think you're on the night shift.
translation: Посмотри график, по-моему, ты в ночную смену.

definition: the state of having no money to pay what you owe
sentence: The shop closed after the owner's {bankruptcy}.
translation: Магазин закрылся после банкротства владельца.

definition: a piece of clothing for women that hangs from the waist
sentence: I bought a long {skirt} for the party.
translation: Я купила длинную юбку на вечеринку.

definition: the way the parts of something are arranged
sentence: I like the {layout} of the flat, the kitchen is next to the balcony.
translation: Мне нравится планировка квартиры, кухня рядом с балконом.

definition: to officially order someone to come
sentence: The boss {summoned} me to her office right after lunch.
translation: Начальница вызвала меня к себе сразу после обеда.

definition: to go or come down
sentence: We {descended} the stairs slowly because of the ice.
translation: Мы медленно спускались по лестнице из-за льда.

definition: an insect with large colourful wings
sentence: A {butterfly} landed on my coffee cup in the garden.
translation: В саду на мою чашку кофе села бабочка.

definition: the thick main part of a tree
sentence: We sat on the fallen {trunk} and had our sandwiches.
translation: Мы сели на упавший ствол и съели бутерброды.

definition: a friend, in informal speech
sentence: I'm going to the match with an old {pal} from school.
translation: Иду на матч со старым школьным приятелем.

definition: the front part of your body below the chest
sentence: The dog rolled over so I could rub his {belly}.
translation: Пёс перевернулся, чтобы я почесал ему живот.

definition: to let out a long breath because you are tired, sad or relieved
sentence: She {sighed} and put the phone down without answering.
translation: Она вздохнула и отложила телефон, не ответив.

definition: a person whose job is building or repairing houses
sentence: The {builders} promised to finish the roof by Friday.
translation: Строители обещали закончить крышу к пятнице.

definition: an animal with a hard shell that lives in water or on land
sentence: We saw a huge {turtle} while swimming near the rocks.
translation: Мы видели огромную черепаху, когда плавали у скал.

definition: to make someone want to do something, often something unwise
sentence: Don't {tempt} me with cake, I'm trying to eat less sugar.
translation: Не соблазняй меня тортом, я стараюсь есть меньше сахара.

definition: the player who guards the goal, or a person who looks after something
sentence: Our {keeper} saved two penalties in the final.
translation: Наш вратарь взял два пенальти в финале.

definition: a person who tells lies
sentence: Don't trust him, he's a terrible {liar}.
translation: Не верь ему, он страшный врун.

definition: to pay money so that someone can leave prison before their trial
sentence: His brother {bailed} him out the next morning.
translation: Брат внёс за него залог на следующее утро.

definition: an experienced person who helps and advises someone with less experience
sentence: My {mentor} at work taught me more than university did.
translation: Мой наставник на работе научил меня большему, чем университет.

definition: to pull or carry something heavy with effort
sentence: We {hauled} the sofa up four floors without a lift.
translation: Мы втащили диван на четвёртый этаж без лифта.

definition: a person who pays to receive a service or follows a channel
sentence: Her channel just passed one million {subscribers}.
translation: Её канал только что перевалил за миллион подписчиков.

definition: a powder or seed from a plant used to give food a strong taste
sentence: Which {spice} did you put in the soup? It's lovely.
translation: Какую специю ты добавил в суп? Очень вкусно.

definition: a curve of colours in the sky after rain
sentence: Look, there's a {rainbow} over the river!
translation: Смотри, над рекой радуга!

definition: to make a room or place look nicer with colours or objects
sentence: We {decorated} the living room for the party with balloons.
translation: Мы украсили гостиную шариками к празднику.

definition: to be unable to breathe because something is stuck in your throat
sentence: Chew slowly, you'll {choke} on that bread.
translation: Жуй медленнее, ты подавишься этим хлебом.

definition: a set of numbers or things arranged in rows and columns
sentence: The teacher drew a {matrix} on the board to explain it.
translation: Учитель начертил на доске матрицу, чтобы объяснить.

definition: the lawyers who try to prove in court that someone is guilty
sentence: The {prosecution} asked for three years in prison.
translation: Обвинение попросило три года тюрьмы.

definition: a table or small shop in a market where things are sold
sentence: I bought these cherries from a {stall} at the market.
translation: Я купил эту черешню в палатке на рынке.

definition: the remains of an animal or plant from long ago, kept in rock
sentence: The kids found a {fossil} of a shell on the beach.
translation: Дети нашли на пляже окаменевшую ракушку.

definition: to push liquid or food out of your mouth
sentence: He tasted the soup and {spat} it straight back out.
translation: Он попробовал суп и тут же выплюнул.

definition: a large heavy gun on wheels, used in old wars
sentence: There's an old {cannon} in front of the castle for photos.
translation: Перед замком стоит старая пушка для фотографий.

definition: to begin to exist, to start in a particular place or time
sentence: Pizza {originated} in Naples, not in America.
translation: Пицца появилась в Неаполе, а не в Америке.

definition: a piece of paper that shows you paid for something
sentence: Keep the {receipt} in case the shoes don't fit.
translation: Сохрани чек на случай, если туфли не подойдут.

definition: to officially tell someone about something
sentence: The app will {notify} you when your order is ready.
translation: Приложение сообщит тебе, когда заказ будет готов.

definition: one of several pages open in a browser, or a small label to hold
sentence: Close some {tabs}, your laptop is getting slow.
translation: Закрой несколько вкладок, ноутбук начинает тормозить.

definition: very near or next to something
sentence: Our hotel room was {adjacent} to the lift, so it was noisy.
translation: Наш номер был рядом с лифтом, поэтому было шумно.

definition: the feeling of being thankful or of understanding how good something is
sentence: She brought flowers as a sign of {appreciation}.
translation: Она принесла цветы в знак благодарности.

definition: strong and good at sport
sentence: He's very {athletic}, he runs every morning before work.
translation: Он очень спортивный, бегает каждое утро перед работой.

definition: causing pain to others on purpose, without pity
sentence: It was {cruel} to leave the dog outside in that rain.
translation: Было жестоко оставить собаку на улице в такой дождь.

definition: a large wild animal with long legs that eats grass
sentence: A {deer} ran across the road right in front of our car.
translation: Олень выбежал на дорогу прямо перед нашей машиной.

definition: an area of flat land where a river splits before the sea
sentence: Thousands of birds spend the winter in the river {delta}.
translation: Тысячи птиц зимуют в дельте реки.

definition: connected with elections
sentence: The {electoral} map changed a lot after this vote.
translation: Карта выборов сильно изменилась после этого голосования.

definition: the number 11
sentence: We need {eleven} chairs, one more than we have.
translation: Нам нужно одиннадцать стульев, на один больше, чем есть.

definition: more than is reasonable or needed
sentence: Twenty euros for a sandwich is {excessive}.
translation: Двадцать евро за сэндвич — это перебор.

definition: rings, necklaces and other decorations that you wear
sentence: She keeps her {jewelry} in a small wooden box.
translation: Она хранит украшения в маленькой деревянной шкатулке.

definition: the work of writing news for newspapers, TV or websites
sentence: She studied {journalism} and now writes for a sports site.
translation: Она училась на журналиста и теперь пишет для спортивного сайта.

definition: going in a straight line, or developing in one clear direction
sentence: The story isn't {linear}, it jumps between two years.
translation: Сюжет не линейный, он прыгает между двумя годами.

definition: happening sometimes but not often
sentence: I'm fine with the {occasional} late night, not every day.
translation: Иногда посидеть допоздна я не против, но не каждый день.

definition: unlucky, or causing a bad situation
sentence: It was {unfortunate} that it rained on the one day we were free.
translation: Как неудачно, что дождь пошёл в единственный свободный день.

definition: the bones of your face that hold your teeth and move when you talk
sentence: My {jaw} hurts from laughing so much last night.
translation: У меня челюсть болит от вчерашнего смеха.

definition: a small thing like a bag or belt that goes with your clothes
sentence: A bright scarf is the only {accessory} this dress needs.
translation: Яркий шарф — единственный аксессуар, который нужен этому платью.

definition: a piece of cloth used for drying yourself
sentence: Bring a {towel}, the pool doesn't give them out.
translation: Возьми полотенце, в бассейне их не выдают.

definition: the state of not being sure what will happen
sentence: There's still some {uncertainty} about the date of the move.
translation: Насчёт даты переезда пока есть неясность.

definition: the act of using numbers to find out an amount
sentence: By my {calculation} we spent more on taxis than on food.
translation: По моим подсчётам, на такси мы потратили больше, чем на еду.

definition: a person who studies how money and business work
sentence: An {economist} on the radio said prices will keep rising.
translation: Экономист по радио сказал, что цены продолжат расти.

definition: a place where dead people are buried
sentence: The old {cemetery} is actually a quiet place for a walk.
translation: Старое кладбище, как ни странно, тихое место для прогулки.

definition: the part of a shirt or coat that goes around your neck
sentence: Turn your {collar} up, it's windy outside.
translation: Подними воротник, на улице ветрено.

definition: the way something is arranged or organised, especially equipment
sentence: Show me your desk {setup}, I want to see the two screens.
translation: Покажи, как у тебя устроено рабочее место, хочу увидеть два экрана.

definition: putting medicine into the body with a needle
sentence: The nurse gave me an {injection} and it didn't hurt at all.
translation: Медсестра сделала мне укол, и было совсем не больно.

definition: a person who asks for a job, a place or a loan
sentence: We had forty {applicants} for one position.
translation: На одно место у нас было сорок кандидатов.

definition: a machine that makes electricity
sentence: The {generator} kept the lights on during the storm.
translation: Во время бури свет горел благодаря генератору.

definition: a lawyer who tries to prove in court that someone is guilty
sentence: The {prosecutor} showed the video to the jury.
translation: Прокурор показал видео присяжным.

definition: a person who buys and sells things like shares or houses for others
sentence: Our {broker} found us a flat in two weeks.
translation: Наш агент нашёл нам квартиру за две недели.

definition: a person who writes rude or stupid comments online to upset people
sentence: Ignore that {troll}, he just wants a fight.
translation: Не обращай внимания на этого тролля, он просто ищет ссоры.

definition: a small soft fruit that grows on a bush
sentence: We picked {berries} in the forest and ate them with cream.
translation: Мы собрали в лесу ягоды и съели их со сливками.

definition: a valuable stone used in rings and necklaces, or something very good
sentence: This little cafe is a real {gem}, nobody knows about it.
translation: Это маленькое кафе — настоящая жемчужина, о нём никто не знает.

definition: to turn around a central point, or to take turns in order
sentence: {Rotate} the photo, it's upside down.
translation: Поверни фото, оно вверх ногами.

definition: a word for someone you love
sentence: Come here, {darling}, let me see your hand.
translation: Иди сюда, дорогая, дай посмотрю руку.

definition: a gun
sentence: You need a licence to own a {firearm} here.
translation: Чтобы владеть огнестрельным оружием здесь, нужна лицензия.

definition: a person believed to speak for God, or someone who says what will happen
sentence: He's no {prophet}, he just guessed the result.
translation: Он не пророк, просто угадал результат.

definition: a way that someone usually behaves or something usually happens
sentence: He has a {tendency} to talk over people.
translation: У него есть привычка перебивать людей.

definition: to load a page again, or to make someone feel less tired
sentence: {Refresh} the page, the tickets should appear now.
translation: Обнови страницу, билеты должны уже появиться.

definition: the smallest part of a substance that is made of atoms
sentence: A water {molecule} has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
translation: Молекула воды состоит из двух атомов водорода и одного атома кислорода.

definition: a person who owns part of a company
sentence: The {shareholders} voted against the new boss.
translation: Акционеры проголосовали против нового руководителя.

definition: the way a surface feels when you touch it
sentence: I love the {texture} of this bread, soft inside and hard outside.
translation: Мне нравится текстура этого хлеба: мягкий внутри и хрустящий снаружи.

definition: a meeting with a doctor or expert to get advice
sentence: The first {consultation} with the lawyer is free.
translation: Первая консультация у юриста бесплатная.

definition: a score in American football made by carrying the ball over the line
sentence: They scored a {touchdown} in the last minute and won.
translation: Они занесли тачдаун на последней минуте и победили.

definition: unwanted emails or messages sent to many people
sentence: Half of my inbox is {spam} about cheap watches.
translation: Половина моей почты — спам про дешёвые часы.

definition: to give a religious talk, or to tell people how they should behave
sentence: Stop {preaching} about healthy food and eat your pizza.
translation: Хватит читать лекции о здоровом питании, ешь свою пиццу.

definition: a message that tells you something has happened
sentence: I turned off {notifications} for that app, they drove me mad.
translation: Я отключил уведомления для этого приложения, они сводили с ума.

definition: connected with thinking, learning and understanding
sentence: Sleep is good for memory and other {cognitive} skills.
translation: Сон полезен для памяти и других умственных способностей.

definition: to do with the teeth and the doctor who looks after them
sentence: I have a {dental} appointment at three, wish me luck.
translation: У меня приём у стоматолога в три, пожелай удачи.

definition: good at dealing with people without upsetting them, or connected with diplomacy
sentence: Be {diplomatic} when you tell her the dress doesn't fit.
translation: Будь тактичен, когда скажешь ей, что платье не подходит.

definition: lasting forever, never ending
sentence: The queue at the post office felt {eternal}.
translation: Очередь на почте казалась бесконечной.

definition: shared by a whole group, not special or specific
sentence: The hotel was fine but a bit {generic}, like any other.
translation: Отель был нормальный, но безликий, как любой другой.

definition: your mother's or father's mother, in informal speech
sentence: My {grandma} still bakes bread every Sunday.
translation: Моя бабушка до сих пор печёт хлеб каждое воскресенье.

definition: the amount you can hold in one hand, or a small number
sentence: Only a {handful} of people came to the early show.
translation: На ранний сеанс пришла лишь горстка людей.

definition: in a happy way, or in a lucky way
sentence: {Happily}, the rain stopped just before the game.
translation: К счастью, дождь перестал прямо перед игрой.

definition: in the area where you live or the area being talked about
sentence: The cheese is made {locally}, on a farm five miles away.
translation: Сыр делают здесь же, на ферме в пяти милях отсюда.

definition: very small in amount, the least possible
sentence: The damage to the car was {minimal}, just a scratch.
translation: Повреждения машины были минимальные, одна царапина.

definition: to do with the smallest parts that things are made of
sentence: She works in a {molecular} biology lab.
translation: Она работает в лаборатории молекулярной биологии.

definition: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day
sentence: Let's meet at {noon} and have lunch together.
translation: Давай встретимся в полдень и пообедаем вместе.

definition: at the present time, compared with the past
sentence: {Nowadays} nobody writes letters, everyone texts.
translation: В наши дни никто не пишет писем, все шлют сообщения.

definition: without hiding anything, honestly
sentence: He talks {openly} about his illness, which takes courage.
translation: Он открыто говорит о своей болезни, это требует смелости.

definition: a short general description of something
sentence: Give me a quick {overview} of the plan before the meeting.
translation: Дай мне краткий обзор плана перед встречей.

definition: so weak or bad that it makes you feel pity or anger
sentence: My attempt at cooking rice was {pathetic}, it all burned.
translation: Моя попытка сварить рис была жалкой, всё сгорело.

definition: caring only about yourself and not about other people
sentence: It's {selfish} to take the last piece without asking.
translation: Эгоистично брать последний кусок, не спросив.

definition: the box in a kitchen where you bake or roast food
sentence: Put the chicken in the {oven} for forty minutes.
translation: Поставь курицу в духовку на сорок минут.

definition: an object used on stage or in a film
sentence: The sword is just a {prop}, it's made of plastic.
translation: Меч — просто бутафория, он из пластика.

definition: not fat, with a body that looks good
sentence: She looks {slim} in that dress.
translation: В этом платье она выглядит стройной.

definition: a short period of illness or strong feeling
sentence: I had a {bout} of flu and missed a whole week of work.
translation: У меня был приступ гриппа, и я пропустил целую неделю работы.

definition: a long piece of writing done for a university degree
sentence: She's writing her {thesis} about street food in Vietnam.
translation: Она пишет диплом про уличную еду во Вьетнаме.

definition: a statue or building made to remember a person or event
sentence: There's a {monument} to the poet in the main square.
translation: На главной площади стоит памятник поэту.

definition: a person who writes a blog
sentence: A travel {blogger} wrote about our little hotel.
translation: Один тревел-блогер написал о нашем маленьком отеле.

definition: something that stops you from going forward or succeeding
sentence: The biggest {obstacle} to buying a flat is the deposit.
translation: Главное препятствие при покупке квартиры — первый взнос.

definition: a period of work experience, or the act of putting something somewhere
sentence: She got a summer {placement} at a design studio.
translation: Она получила летнюю стажировку в дизайн-студии.

definition: to produce flowers
sentence: The cherry trees {bloom} in early April here.
translation: Вишни здесь цветут в начале апреля.

definition: a book or piece of writing before it is printed
sentence: She sent the {manuscript} to five publishers and waited.
translation: Она отправила рукопись пяти издателям и стала ждать.

definition: one part of a course or system that can be used on its own
sentence: The first {module} of the course is about grammar.
translation: Первый модуль курса посвящён грамматике.

definition: a frame with bars or shelves for holding things
sentence: Hang the wet coats on the {rack} by the door.
translation: Повесь мокрые куртки на вешалку у двери.

definition: light in colour, or having a face with less colour than usual
sentence: You look {pale}, are you feeling okay?
translation: Ты бледный, ты хорошо себя чувствуешь?

definition: a surprising fact that becomes known
sentence: It was a {revelation} that my quiet uncle used to be a DJ.
translation: Для меня было открытием, что мой тихий дядя когда-то был диджеем.

definition: to receive money or property from someone after their death
sentence: She {inherited} the house from her grandmother.
translation: Она унаследовала дом от бабушки.

definition: the part of your body between your hand and your arm
sentence: I hurt my {wrist} playing volleyball on the beach.
translation: Я повредил запястье, играя в волейбол на пляже.

definition: a short sound made by a clock, or a mark that shows something is correct
sentence: Put a {tick} next to the days you can come.
translation: Поставь галочку напротив дней, когда можешь прийти.

definition: to end something officially, such as a contract or job
sentence: They {terminated} my contract two weeks before the end.
translation: Они расторгли мой контракт за две недели до конца.

definition: to make something easier to understand by explaining it
sentence: Could you {clarify} what you meant by 'soon'?
translation: Можешь уточнить, что ты имел в виду под «скоро»?

definition: a set of beliefs and ideas that a political group or person has
sentence: I don't share his {ideology}, but he is a good neighbour.
translation: Я не разделяю его взгляды, но сосед он хороший.

definition: to mix with a liquid and become part of it
sentence: Stir until the sugar {dissolves} completely.
translation: Мешай, пока сахар полностью не растворится.

definition: to say firmly that something is true
sentence: He {asserted} that the car was already damaged when he got it.
translation: Он твёрдо заявил, что машина была повреждена ещё до него.

definition: a paper from a doctor that lets you get medicine
sentence: You can't buy these pills without a {prescription}.
translation: Эти таблетки без рецепта не продадут.

definition: a person whose job is to give advice
sentence: My financial {adviser} told me to wait before buying.
translation: Мой финансовый консультант посоветовал подождать с покупкой.

definition: a flat round object, or a part of a computer that stores data
sentence: The old {disk} is full, we need to delete some photos.
translation: Старый диск заполнен, нужно удалить часть фотографий.

definition: two people who perform or work together
sentence: The two sisters sing as a {duo} in local bars.
translation: Две сестры выступают дуэтом в местных барах.

definition: a machine that puts text or pictures from a computer onto paper
sentence: The {printer} is out of ink again.
translation: В принтере опять закончились чернила.

definition: a man in stories who has magic powers
sentence: My son wants to be a {wizard} at the party, with a hat.
translation: Сын хочет быть на празднике волшебником, со шляпой и всем прочим.

definition: to change the words of a law, rule or document
sentence: We {amended} the contract to include the parking space.
translation: Мы внесли в договор правку, добавив парковочное место.

definition: a pen with a thick point, or a sign that shows where something is
sentence: Use a black {marker} so people can read the sign from far away.
translation: Пиши чёрным маркером, чтобы надпись было видно издалека.

definition: a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
sentence: Somebody call an {ambulance}, he can't stand up!
translation: Кто-нибудь, вызовите скорую, он не может встать!

definition: a shape with straight sides and round ends, like a tube
sentence: The gas comes in a metal {cylinder} that lasts a month.
translation: Газ продаётся в металлическом баллоне, которого хватает на месяц.

definition: a quantity with a size and a direction, shown as an arrow
sentence: The teacher drew a {vector} to show the direction of the wind.
translation: Учитель нарисовал вектор, чтобы показать направление ветра.

definition: a straight line across the middle of a circle
sentence: The pizza is thirty centimetres in {diameter}, enough for two.
translation: Пицца тридцать сантиметров в диаметре, хватит на двоих.

definition: a person in your family who lived a long time ago
sentence: My {ancestors} came here from Italy a hundred years ago.
translation: Мои предки приехали сюда из Италии сто лет назад.

definition: the natural place where an animal or plant lives
sentence: The forest is the natural {habitat} of these owls.
translation: Лес — естественная среда обитания этих сов.

definition: a dishonest plan for getting money from people
sentence: That email about a prize is a {scam}, don't click anything.
translation: Это письмо о призе — мошенничество, ничего не нажимай.

definition: a film or play made from a book, or the process of changing to fit
sentence: The new {adaptation} of the novel is better than the book.
translation: Новая экранизация романа лучше самой книги.

definition: a person who watches over workers or students and their work
sentence: My {supervisor} let me leave early for the dentist.
translation: Мой руководитель отпустил меня пораньше к стоматологу.

definition: to put your name on a list to join a course or school
sentence: I {enrolled} in an evening Spanish class.
translation: Я записался на вечерние курсы испанского.

definition: a product that can be bought and sold, like oil or coffee
sentence: Coffee is the second most traded {commodity} in the world.
translation: Кофе — второй по объёму торговли товар в мире.

definition: to begin, in formal language
sentence: The concert will {commence} at eight sharp.
translation: Концерт начнётся ровно в восемь.

definition: very cruel or violent, or very hard and direct
sentence: The heat in August here is {brutal}.
translation: Жара здесь в августе просто беспощадная.

definition: the legal right of belonging to a country
sentence: She got her {citizenship} last year and voted for the first time.
translation: В прошлом году она получила гражданство и впервые проголосовала.

definition: agreement among all the people in a group
sentence: After an hour we reached a {consensus}: pizza, not sushi.
translation: Через час мы пришли к общему решению: пицца, а не суши.

definition: connected with the face
sentence: You could see from his {facial} expression that he was lying.
translation: По выражению его лица было видно, что он врёт.

definition: staying with and supporting a person, idea or team for a long time
sentence: He's been a {faithful} fan of the club for thirty years.
translation: Он тридцать лет остаётся преданным болельщиком клуба.

definition: causing death, or causing complete failure
sentence: The crash was almost {fatal}, he spent a month in hospital.
translation: Авария чуть не стала смертельной, он провёл месяц в больнице.

definition: really and honestly, not pretending
sentence: I'm {genuinely} happy for you, this job is perfect.
translation: Я искренне рад за тебя, эта работа тебе идеально подходит.

definition: the feeling of needing or wanting food
sentence: After the long walk the {hunger} was unbearable.
translation: После долгой прогулки голод был невыносимым.

definition: using new ideas and methods
sentence: The app has an {innovative} way of saving your tickets.
translation: В приложении придуман новый способ хранить билеты.

definition: the sound of people laughing
sentence: I could hear {laughter} from the kitchen all evening.
translation: Весь вечер из кухни доносился смех.

definition: very strong and powerful
sentence: The river is {mighty} in spring when the snow melts.
translation: Весной, когда тает снег, река становится могучей.

definition: connected with money
sentence: The prize has no {monetary} value, it's just a medal.
translation: У приза нет денежной ценности, это просто медаль.

definition: the food you eat and the way it keeps you healthy
sentence: Good {nutrition} matters more than any gym.
translation: Правильное питание важнее любого спортзала.

definition: badly, not well
sentence: The flat was {poorly} heated, so we slept in our coats.
translation: Квартира плохо отапливалась, и мы спали в куртках.

definition: only, completely, with no other reason
sentence: I bought the car {purely} because of its colour.
translation: Я купил машину исключительно из-за цвета.

definition: appearing to be true, although it may not be
sentence: He was {seemingly} calm, but his hands were shaking.
translation: Он казался спокойным, но руки у него дрожали.

definition: very badly or seriously
sentence: The old bridge was {severely} damaged by the flood.
translation: Старый мост был серьёзно повреждён наводнением.

definition: the direction between south and west, or that part of a country
sentence: The best beaches are in the {southwest} of the island.
translation: Лучшие пляжи на юго-западе острова.

definition: according to the exact facts or rules, even if it seems different
sentence: {Technically} we're still at work, but everyone is watching the match.
translation: Формально мы ещё на работе, но все смотрят матч.

definition: without any limit, as much as you want
sentence: The ticket gives you {unlimited} travel on buses for a day.
translation: Билет даёт безлимитный проезд на автобусах на день.

definition: a person killed or injured in an accident or war
sentence: Luckily there were no {casualties} in the fire.
translation: К счастью, при пожаре никто не пострадал.

definition: a small house in the countryside
sentence: We rented a {cottage} by the lake for the weekend.
translation: Мы сняли домик у озера на выходные.

definition: money given back to you because you returned something or paid too much
sentence: The shop gave me a full {refund} for the broken lamp.
translation: Магазин полностью вернул мне деньги за сломанную лампу.

definition: a man who works in business, often owning a company
sentence: The hotel belongs to a {businessman} from the city.
translation: Отель принадлежит одному бизнесмену из города.

definition: a short or funny name used instead of someone's real name
sentence: Everyone at school called him by his {nickname}, Tiger.
translation: В школе все звали его по прозвищу — Тигр.

definition: a picture, text or video that tries to make people buy something
sentence: I saw an {advertisement} for the course on the bus.
translation: Я увидел рекламу курса в автобусе.

definition: one part of a legal document, or a part of a sentence
sentence: Read the {clause} about cancellation before you sign.
translation: Прочитай пункт об отмене, прежде чем подписывать.

definition: a society with its own culture and way of life, especially an advanced one
sentence: The museum has objects from an ancient {civilization}.
translation: В музее есть предметы древней цивилизации.

definition: a small coloured rubber bag filled with air for parties
sentence: The kids ran around the garden with a red {balloon} each.
translation: Дети бегали по саду, у каждого по красному шарику.

definition: the place where people work
sentence: Our {workplace} has free fruit and a terrible coffee machine.
translation: У нас на работе бесплатные фрукты и ужасная кофемашина.

definition: to take control of a country by force, or to win against a problem
sentence: She finally {conquered} her fear of driving.
translation: Она наконец победила страх вождения.

definition: to move on your hands and knees, or very slowly
sentence: The baby {crawled} straight to the dog's bowl.
translation: Малыш пополз прямо к миске собаки.

definition: a small change made to something
sentence: The car needs a small {modification} to use the new fuel.
translation: Машине нужна небольшая доработка под новое топливо.

definition: the joint between your foot and your leg
sentence: I twisted my {ankle} on the stairs and can barely walk.
translation: Я подвернул лодыжку на лестнице и еле хожу.

definition: a strong wish to be successful or achieve something big
sentence: My {ambition} is to open my own bakery one day.
translation: Моя мечта — однажды открыть собственную пекарню.

definition: a very small insect that lives in large groups
sentence: There are {ants} all over the kitchen again.
translation: На кухне опять повсюду муравьи.

definition: to ride on waves standing on a board, or to look through the internet
sentence: We {surfed} every morning before breakfast on holiday.
translation: В отпуске мы каждое утро катались на серфе до завтрака.

definition: a long narrow line of colour
sentence: The shirt is white with a thin blue {stripe}.
translation: Рубашка белая с тонкой синей полоской.

definition: a piece of equipment with steps for climbing up
sentence: Hold the {ladder} while I change the light bulb.
translation: Подержи лестницу, пока я меняю лампочку.

definition: a small area of still water, smaller than a lake
sentence: There are frogs in the {pond} behind the house.
translation: В пруду за домом живут лягушки.

definition: to suffer or die because you have no food
sentence: Let's order something now, I'm {starving} after that walk.
translation: Давай уже закажем, я умираю с голоду.

definition: something you enjoy doing in your free time
sentence: Photography is my {hobby}, not my job.
translation: Фотография — моё хобби, а не работа.

definition: a feeling that someone has done something wrong
sentence: I have a {suspicion} that he read my messages.
translation: Подозреваю, что он читал мои сообщения.

definition: to break a bone
sentence: She {fractured} her arm falling off the bike.
translation: Она сломала руку, упав с велосипеда.

definition: to put things in a straight line or make them match each other
sentence: {Align} the pictures so they hang at the same height.
translation: Выровняй картины, чтобы они висели на одной высоте.

definition: the state of having many parts that are hard to understand
sentence: The {complexity} of the tax form surprised me.
translation: Сложность налоговой формы меня удивила.

definition: a basket on wheels used in a shop, or a vehicle pulled by an animal
sentence: My {cart} was full and I still forgot the milk.
translation: Тележка была полная, а молоко я всё равно забыл.

definition: something put in a place to make it look nicer
sentence: We put up the {decorations} for New Year a week early.
translation: Мы повесили новогодние украшения на неделю раньше.

definition: a small unit for measuring weight
sentence: Add two hundred {grams} of flour and mix.
translation: Добавь двести граммов муки и перемешай.

definition: a chemical in the body that controls how it grows and works
sentence: Lack of sleep changes your {hormones} and makes you hungry.
translation: Недосып меняет гормоны и вызывает голод.

definition: a musician who speaks words fast in rhythm over music
sentence: The {rapper} from our town is playing a big festival now.
translation: Рэпер из нашего города теперь выступает на большом фестивале.

definition: to make something certain to fail or end badly
sentence: The project was {doomed} from the start, nobody had time.
translation: Проект был обречён с самого начала, ни у кого не было времени.

definition: to destroy completely, or to make someone extremely sad
sentence: The news of his death {devastated} the whole village.
translation: Известие о его смерти потрясло всю деревню.

definition: a narrow piece of leather or cloth used to hold or carry something
sentence: The {strap} on my bag broke in the middle of the street.
translation: Ремешок на моей сумке порвался прямо посреди улицы.

definition: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
sentence: The village has only two hundred {inhabitants}.
translation: В деревне всего двести жителей.

definition: a person who works underground digging out coal or metal
sentence: My grandfather was a {miner} and never saw the sun at work.
translation: Мой дед был шахтёром и на работе не видел солнца.

definition: a single piece of hair, or a long piece of something like hair
sentence: There's a {strand} of hair in my soup.
translation: У меня в супе волос.

definition: a person kept by force so that others will do what you want
sentence: The robbers took two {hostages} but let them go an hour later.
translation: Грабители взяли двух заложников, но через час отпустили.

definition: worried and nervous about something that might happen
sentence: I'm {anxious} about the test results tomorrow.
translation: Я тревожусь из-за завтрашних результатов анализов.

definition: milk and foods made from milk, like cheese and butter
sentence: I stopped eating {dairy} and my skin got better.
translation: Я перестал есть молочное, и кожа стала лучше.

definition: the way an organisation or country is controlled and managed
sentence: The club's poor {governance} led to all these debts.
translation: Плохое управление клубом привело ко всем этим долгам.

definition: used to show that something matters a lot
sentence: The flat is cheap and, more {importantly}, close to work.
translation: Квартира дешёвая и, что важнее, близко к работе.

definition: inside a building
sentence: There's an {indoor} pool, so the rain doesn't matter.
translation: Там крытый бассейн, так что дождь не помеха.

definition: having a lot of power to change what people think or do
sentence: Her blog is {influential}, one post can fill a restaurant.
translation: Её блог очень влиятелен: один пост может заполнить ресторан.

definition: impossible to see
sentence: The stain is {invisible} now, you can't tell where it was.
translation: Пятно теперь не видно, и не скажешь, где оно было.

definition: having or showing very strong feelings about something
sentence: He's {passionate} about old cars and can talk for hours.
translation: Он без ума от старых машин и может говорить о них часами.

definition: in a way that you did not expect
sentence: The cheap wine was {surprisingly} good.
translation: Дешёвое вино оказалось на удивление хорошим.

definition: feeling that something is wrong, or making people feel that way
sentence: A {suspicious} man was looking at the cars in our street.
translation: По нашей улице ходил подозрительный тип и разглядывал машины.

definition: completely and with great care
sentence: Wash the mushrooms {thoroughly} before cooking.
translation: Тщательно вымой грибы перед готовкой.

definition: a machine that cleans floors by sucking up dirt, or a space with no air
sentence: The {vacuum} is in the cupboard under the stairs.
translation: Пылесос в шкафу под лестницей.

definition: a small broken piece of something
sentence: I found a {fragment} of the plate under the table.
translation: Я нашёл осколок тарелки под столом.

definition: the soft thing you rest your head on in bed
sentence: This {pillow} is too hard, I woke up with a sore neck.
translation: Эта подушка слишком жёсткая, я проснулся с больной шеей.

definition: to make a feeling or idea known to someone
sentence: It's hard to {convey} how beautiful the view was.
translation: Трудно передать, какой красивый там был вид.

definition: a smart sea animal with a long nose that jumps out of the water
sentence: A {dolphin} swam next to our boat for ten minutes.
translation: Дельфин десять минут плыл рядом с нашей лодкой.

definition: the main body of a ship
sentence: The {hull} was painted white and blue like the flag.
translation: Корпус судна был выкрашен в белый и синий, как флаг.

definition: the general feeling or mood of a place or person, informally
sentence: I love the {vibe} in this bar, nobody is in a hurry.
translation: Мне нравится атмосфера в этом баре, никто никуда не спешит.

definition: to get something back from the place where you left it
sentence: I went back to {retrieve} my umbrella from the bar.
translation: Я вернулся в бар, чтобы забрать свой зонт.

definition: your husband or wife
sentence: Write your {spouse}'s name on the second line of the form.
translation: Напишите имя супруга во второй строке анкеты.

definition: a public opinion or position on a particular question
sentence: What's your {stance} on working from home?
translation: Как ты относишься к работе из дома?

definition: a long narrow hole dug along a road or field for water
sentence: The car slid off the road into a {ditch}, but nobody was hurt.
translation: Машина съехала с дороги в канаву, но никто не пострадал.

definition: a person whose job is to make people laugh
sentence: The {comedian} talked about airports for twenty minutes.
translation: Комик двадцать минут рассказывал про аэропорты.

definition: to say what medicine someone should take, as a doctor
sentence: The doctor {prescribed} rest and plenty of water.
translation: Врач прописал покой и побольше воды.

definition: to move your tongue over something
sentence: The dog {licked} my face as soon as I opened the door.
translation: Пёс лизнул меня в лицо, едва я открыл дверь.

definition: a person or thing that comes after another and takes its place
sentence: Nobody knows who the manager's {successor} will be.
translation: Никто не знает, кто станет преемником менеджера.

definition: to understand a difficult idea completely
sentence: It took me a while to {grasp} how the game works.
translation: Мне понадобилось время, чтобы понять, как устроена игра.

definition: deep sadness, especially after someone has died
sentence: It took him years to get over the {grief} of losing his wife.
translation: Ему понадобились годы, чтобы пережить горе после потери жены.

definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
sentence: After that goal, defeat was {inevitable}.
translation: После того гола поражение было неизбежно.

definition: not obvious, small and hard to notice
sentence: There's a {subtle} difference between the two colours.
translation: Между этими двумя цветами едва заметная разница.

definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who has problems
sentence: I have a lot of {sympathy} for people working night shifts.
translation: Мне очень жаль людей, которые работают в ночную смену.

definition: to make something more active or make it grow
sentence: A short walk {stimulates} my brain better than coffee.
translation: Короткая прогулка бодрит мой мозг лучше кофе.

definition: a movement of your hand or head that shows what you mean
sentence: She made a {gesture} for me to sit down.
translation: Она жестом показала, чтобы я сел.

definition: not friendly, ready to fight
sentence: The waiter was {hostile} from the moment we sat down.
translation: Официант был враждебно настроен с той минуты, как мы сели.

definition: a good quality in a person's character
sentence: Her greatest {virtue} is that she never lies.
translation: Её главное достоинство в том, что она никогда не врёт.

definition: to control or influence someone in a clever, unfair way
sentence: He {manipulated} his friends into paying for everything.
translation: Он так ловко всё устроил, что друзья за всё заплатили.

definition: to become smaller in size or amount
sentence: My favourite sweater {shrank} in the wash.
translation: Мой любимый свитер сел после стирки.

definition: a great success or victory
sentence: Finishing the marathon was a personal {triumph} for me.
translation: Финиш марафона стал для меня личным триумфом.

definition: a natural feeling that makes you act without thinking
sentence: My first {instinct} was to run, but I stayed.
translation: Первым порывом было убежать, но я остался.

definition: the decision of a court about whether someone is guilty
sentence: The jury took two days to reach a {verdict}.
translation: Присяжным понадобилось два дня, чтобы вынести вердикт.

definition: special skill or knowledge in a particular area
sentence: We need someone with {expertise} in tax law.
translation: Нам нужен кто-то с опытом в налоговом праве.

definition: probably, judging by what you know
sentence: {Presumably} he's stuck in traffic again.
translation: Наверное, он опять застрял в пробке.

definition: a situation where there is not enough of something
sentence: There's a {shortage} of nurses in every hospital here.
translation: Здесь в каждой больнице не хватает медсестёр.

definition: enough in amount or good enough for a purpose
sentence: The flat is small but {adequate} for one person.
translation: Квартира маленькая, но для одного человека вполне подходит.

definition: speaking honestly, even if it is not pleasant
sentence: {Frankly}, I don't think the dress suits you.
translation: Честно говоря, не думаю, что это платье тебе идёт.
